author: Bryan Guffey
message:
fix: bestWindows no longer requires availability on the departure morning

Two compounding problems made the ranking miss real candidates:

1. The window shape required a day-3 first-half slot — a 4th calendar
   day of availability for a 3-night stay. The survey's end-portion
   semantics ('full' vs 'leaving midday') already encode the last
   night, so anyone who entered exactly the weekend they meant
   (Fri-Sun) matched zero windows. Verified against prod data: one
   respondent's six weekend ranges all counted for nothing.
2. The top list allowed overlapping windows, so shifted copies of one
   peak crowded out distinct alternatives. The list is now greedily
   de-clustered (non-overlapping), and the organizer view shows 5.

On today's data this surfaces Fri Oct 23-26 as the true best window
(11 of 16, previously invisible) and puts Fri Oct 2-5 (10 of 16) on
the board — it previously ranked 8th at 9 and never displayed.

fix: resolve workerd export conditions in Vite SSR build

node-flavored builds (bare Buffer.prototype.base64urlSlice.call) into the
worker bundle; workerd's stricter Buffer polyfill throws 'The "start"
argument must be of type number' on every OAuth login. Resolve with
workerd/worker conditions so the packages' own pure-JS web builds ship.
